description: Create or update an auto-crosspost rule on Studio or Pro: pick any connected readable account as source (X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Company Pages, Pinterest or TikTok) and mirror new native posts to other connected accounts automatically. Never mirrors posts published before the rule is created, prevents echo loops on two-way setups, respects skip tags (default #nocrosspost), and enforces plan limits and X read/write ceilings. Show the customer the source, destinations and settings before enabling.

adaptLength.description: What to do when a source post exceeds a destination network’s character limit: "truncate" (default, trims cleanly with ellipsis), "thread" (splits into native chained replies on X, Bluesky, Mastodon and Threads) or "skip".

appendTags.description: Up to 10 hashtags appended to mirrored copies on this route when not already present (defaults to []).

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

destinationAccountIds.description: 1 or more connected destination account ids from accounts_list (up to 5 on Studio, 15 on Pro). Cannot include the source account.

id.description: A rule id from crossposts_list to update. Leave out to create a new rule.

includeMedia.description: Mirror attached photos to destination accounts within workspace upload limits (default true).

includeSourceLink.description: Append the original post URL to mirrored posts (default false).

includeVideo.description: Mirror attached MP4 videos (up to 25 MB) to video-capable destinations including X, Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, Facebook and YouTube within monthly video upload limits (default matches includeMedia).

on.description: Set true to watch and mirror automatically (default true), or false to keep the rule paused.

quoteMode.description: What to do when a source post quotes another post: "link" (default, carries over the quoted post URL) or "skip".

skipTags.description: Up to 10 tags that stop a post from mirroring (defaults to ["#nocrosspost"]). Case-insensitive.

sourceAccountId.description: The connected source account id from accounts_list to watch for new native posts (X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Company Pages, Pinterest or TikTok).

stitchThreads.description: Stitch native self-reply threads from Bluesky, Mastodon or X into one long-form post on LinkedIn and other long networks, or preserve them as chained native threads when adaptLength is "thread" (defaults to true on Bluesky and Mastodon; false on X to conserve monthly X source reads).

name: crossposts_save
title: Save an auto-crosspost rule
